description: Sell some or all of a token back to ETH, on Uniswap or a PONS bonding curve. Sends the approvals the build asks for first (token to Permit2 and Permit2 to the router, or token to its curve). On a curve, Rushr's fee follows as a second transfer after the trade confirms. Sells are never blocked on impact or risk. Returns the tx hashes and explorer links.

amount.description: Exact token base units instead of percent.

percent.description: Share of the holding to sell (default 100).

name: sell
title: Sell a token for ETH
